{{dablink|For other uses of the word "mountain," see [[Mountain]].}}
The '''mountain king''' is a snake found in the mountainous regions of the [[Aiel Waste]].

==Description==
The red-headed mountain king has rings of red and white that strips its body. Within a hour the venom of its bite causes first of all tremors than cramping followed by full-body paroxysms ending in death.{{ref|[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game#Dragon Magazine Article|Dragon Magazine "Beasts of the Wheel of Time"]]}} [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] is warned by [[Amys]] that a mountain king is as deadly in the [[Tel'aran'rhiod|dream]] as it is in the waking world.{{ref/book|4|52}}
